title: Doctor, clinic, dentist or therapist (YMYL, privacy rules)
basis: Recalled general knowledge, 2026-10-22; hosts not re-fetched (UNVERIFIED). In the US patient privacy (HIPAA) limits how a practice may reply to reviews; the pack says so. Another country needs its own rules.

domainTypes.note: bookings platform; listing is a paid product

domainTypes.cost: its physician directory is fed by data suppliers and paid placement

domainTypes.note: American Dental Association: find-a-dentist for members

patterns.why: a state or county medical or dental society
a hospital or health system with an affiliated-provider directory
an insurer's find-a-provider directory (a citation; no link is expected)

angles: Claim the provider profiles (Healthgrades, Vitals, the hospital's affiliated-provider page, the society's find-a-provider) with one identical name, credentials, NPI or licence number, address and phone.
Ask each insurer and hospital you are in-network with to confirm the directory entry is correct; wrong addresses cost patients.
Write patient-education pages reviewed by a named clinician (name, credentials, date reviewed); schools, libraries and local news cite these.
Offer a community talk or screening day; get it on the library, chamber and city calendars.
Answer local health-reporter requests with a clinician's quote.
avoid: Replying to a review in a way that confirms the person is a patient or mentions their care (HIPAA in the US).
Review incentives such as discounts for five stars, and review gating.
Guarantees of results and unsupported claims in listings; health claims are checked closely.
Paid link packages on health-blog networks.
